description: Deployments: ways to put a Component together, each placing named Instances of its children and of the Components it imports, and Connections from an Instance to what offers the Interactions it uses. Optional: a Component with no Deployment is complete. Extends Kernel, Contexts and Operations.

axioms.about: An Instance is of a child of the deployed Component, or of a Component it imports
axioms.formula: all i in Instance. i.of in i.deployment.deployed.components or i.of in i.deployment.deployed.importedComponents

axioms.about: No two Instances of a Deployment share a name
axioms.formula: all a in Instance, b in Instance. (a != b and a.deployment == b.deployment) => a.name != b.name

axioms.about: A Connection goes from an Instance of its own Deployment
axioms.formula: all c in Connection. c.from.deployment == c.deployment

axioms.about: A Connection goes to exactly one thing: an Instance, or the deployed Component
axioms.formula: all c in Connection. (some c.toInstance and no c.toComponent) or (no c.toInstance and some c.toComponent)

axioms.about: A Connection goes to an Instance of its own Deployment
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, t in c.toInstance. t.deployment == c.deployment

axioms.about: A Connection to a Component goes to the deployed Component
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, k in c.toComponent. k == c.deployment.deployed

axioms.about: The Instance a Connection goes to offers its What
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, i in c.what, t in c.toInstance. i.component == t.of

axioms.about: The deployed Component a Connection goes to offers or imports its What
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, i in c.what, k in c.toComponent. i.component == k or i in k.importedInteractions or i.component in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: A Connection's What is accessible to the Component it goes from
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, i in c.what. i.component in c.from.of.*parent or i in c.from.of.importedInteractions or i.component in c.from.of.importedComponents

axioms.about: A Connection's What is over one Language
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, a in c.what, b in c.what. a.language == b.language
